title: Evening Sunwatch
text:
🌇 Evening Sunwatch — September 22, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B5.7)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C1.1 (Peaked September 22, 2026 at 17:58 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 291 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.67)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

All quiet on the Sunwatch front. 👀☀️

A few bright active regions and a broad dark coronal structure are visible, while the coronagraph shows no clear large outward feature.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 304/211/171 Å Composite
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
